terms.gloss: a part of speech: noun, verb, adverb and the rest
terms.grammar: noun phrase: pars, third declension, with the genitive ōrātiōnis
evidence: Quint. 1.4.19: noster sermō articulōs nōn dēsīderat, ideōque in aliās partēs ōrātiōnis sparguntur
Quint. 1.5.48: fīunt soloecismī et quidem plūrimī per partēs ōrātiōnis
terms.comment: Literally “a part of speech”: ōrātiō is speech, language, and its parts are the kinds of word. Quintilian (1.4.18–20) tells how the ancients counted first three (verba, nōmina, convinctiōnēs) and later eight. The teacher’s question is Quae pars ōrātiōnis est?, what part of speech is it?

phrases.latin: fīunt soloecismī et quidem plūrimī per partēs ōrātiōnis
phrases.english: mistakes of grammar happen, and very many of them, through the parts of speech
